title: Peveler et al. (2016): Single-channel sensing and detection-limit matrix

conflictPairs.label: Source qualification 1
conflictPairs.source_text: Main text gives CX544/tetryl LOD 1.2 µg/mL; SI Table S2 gives 0.23 µg/mL. Both retained. Sources: Main PDF p.2, System Design and Synthesis; SI PDF p.19, LOD Calculations and Table S2.
conflictPairs.resolution: Source statements and limits are retained without silent correction.

conflictPairs.label: Source qualification 2
conflictPairs.source_text: Main text describes OMe608 DNT/TNT/tetryl LODs below 0.2 µg/mL; SI gives tetryl 0.21 µg/mL. Neither is silently substituted. Sources: Main PDF p.3, sensing discussion; SI PDF p.19, LOD Calculations and Table S2.
conflictPairs.resolution: Source statements and limits are retained without silent correction.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
